en: A color illustration viewed from an elevated garden with flowering plants in the foreground, looking down over the red‑tiled roofs of a European city. Dominating the center is a richly ornamented yellowish building with a large central dome flanked by several corner towers with spires, resembling a 19th‑century town hall or administrative palace. Church towers with baroque and gothic spires rise among densely packed buildings, and a river meanders through the distant background.
